what: The tree the create-ticket pre-flight of step 7 runs: the ticket-creation guard, its policy and binding grammar, the stdlib-only handlers the guard loads by path (handler_lane_intake, OMN-17942 rules 11-14), and the refusal recorder's lane reader the sidecar-plus-CLAIM resolution sits on. tests/test_lane_intake.py runs the real guard over the payload SKILL.md documents, so CI fetches exactly these paths at this commit and exports CREATE_TICKET_GUARD_ROOT. A live branch is deliberately not read: the pre-flight's own transcription in this SKILL.md is pinned to a commit for the same reason.
